_comment: rock_wall: a reusable map element. Origin at the base centre, y=0 is the ground. One textured material (the tower's 128x128 atlas + emissive), one UV set, no skin, no animation. RockWallCollision is the purpose-built convex collider shipped as a `-colonly` node; Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` stays 1 and `max_tris` counts only what is drawn.
